contract.definition: Publisher-stated date the IP right application was filed/lodged (application.application_date). It is the application's own filing date, not the party-role validity start, not the business establishment date and not a registration date.

Publisher's identifier for the IP right application (application.application_number, repeated as party_activity.application_number), as published. It identifies the application only in combination with the IP right type; it is not a business registration number, ABN or ACN, and does not identify the party or the business.

Publisher-stated date on which the IP right application is deemed retired (application.deemed_retired_date). Frequently blank; a blank must not be read as 'still active'. It is an application-level date, not the end of a party-role association and not the end of the business.

Publisher-stated earliest filing date recorded for the IP right application (application.earliest_filed_date), which may precede the current application's own filing date where an earlier filing is carried forward. It is an application-level date, not the party-role validity start and not a business date.

Publisher-stated date on which the IP right application gained enforceable status (application.gained_enforceable_status_date). Frequently blank; a blank must not be read as 'not enforceable'. It is an application-level milestone and does not assert that any right is in fact enforceable against any party.

Publisher's sub-classification of the IP right application within its IP right type (application.ip_right_sub_type). For patents the observed vocabulary includes standard_complete, innovation, provisional and petty; the list is not asserted to be exhaustive of the publisher's vocabulary. It describes the application's own category and does not imply grant, enforceability or a business attribute.

Publisher's classification of the kind of IP right the application seeks (application.ip_right_type, repeated as party_activity.ip_right_type), e.g. patent. It classifies the application, not the party or the business, and does not state that any right has been granted or is enforceable. The value list reflects the patent-prefix cohort in this snapshot and is not a general IP-right-type vocabulary.

Publisher-stated priority date of the IP right application (application.priority_date), the date from which priority is claimed. It is an application-level legal date, not the filing date, not a grant date and not a business date.

Publisher-stated date on which the IP right application gained registered status (application.gained_registration_status_date). Frequently blank; a blank must not be read as 'never registered'. It is an application-level milestone, not a business incorporation or registration date.

Publisher-stated lifecycle status of the IP right application (application.status), e.g. filed, accepted, granted, lapsed, withdrawn, expired, ceased, unknown. It describes the application's own administrative state at the snapshot; it is not a business status, not evidence of grant or enforceability beyond the stated value, and not a statement about any party. 'ceased' is a publisher-stated application lifecycle state and must not be read as business cessation or as a party's status; 'unknown' is a legitimate publisher-stated state, not a parse failure.

Australian Business Number as supplied on the IP right application party record (party_activity.abn), recorded as an 11-digit string. It is frequently blank, and a blank must not be read as absence of a business or of an Australian presence; it is not validated here and does not establish the party's legal identity.

Country component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.country_code), as published and lower-cased (e.g. 'au', 'us', 'cn'). It is frequently blank, and a blank must not be read as an Australian address or as absence of a country. It is a party-record address attribute, not a statement of the party's place of incorporation or of the business's registered office.

Post code component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.post_code), kept as the raw published string because formats are not uniform (e.g. '2106' vs 'gu14 0lx'). It is a party-record address attribute and is not normalised to an Australian postcode.

State or province component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.state_code), as published and lower-cased (e.g. 'nsw', 'vic'). Values are not restricted to Australian states and are frequently blank; it is a party-record address attribute, not a business operating region or a statement of incorporation.

Publisher's identifier for the party named on an IP right application record (party_activity.party_id). Identifies the party across applications and roles; it is not a business registration number, ABN or ACN, and does not by itself establish a legal entity.

Publisher's classification of the party on the IP right application record as an organisation or an individual (party_activity.party_type). This is a party classification only; it does not state a company legal form, sole-trader status or beneficial ownership.

Party name as published on the IP right application record (party_activity.party_name), free text and lower-cased. It may be an organisation name variant or a personal name; it is not asserted to be a registered legal name or a trading name.

Publisher-stated start of the validity window of the party-role record (party_activity.effective_from_date). It is the commencement of the party's role association on the application, not the application filing/priority date and not the business establishment date.

Publisher-stated end of the validity window of the party-role record (party_activity.effective_to_date), frequently blank when the role is open-ended. It is the end of the party's role association on the application, not the application termination date and not the end of the business.

Publisher's flag stating whether the party-role record is currently valid (party_activity.is_current, true/false). It describes the validity of the party-role association, not the application's status or the business's lifecycle.

Publisher's flag on the party-role record stating whether the party is recorded as founding (party_activity.is_founding, true/false). It is a party-role attribute and must not be read as a business establishment date or as evidence of incorporation.

Publisher's specific role the party holds on the IP right application record (party_activity.party_role), e.g. applicant, patentee, agent, opponent. A finer-grained companion to the role category; it describes the party-role record, not the application or the business lifecycle.

Publisher's broad category of the role the party holds on the IP right application record (party_activity.party_role_category), e.g. applicant, applicant_agent, opposition, mortgagee. Describes the party-role record only; it does not imply ownership, beneficial interest or enforceability of the application.

ip_application.rationale: The application is identified by its number together with the IP right type; application-level status, dates and description belong to the application, not to the party or business.

party_activity.rationale: The record grain is a party in a role on an application; the same party_id can hold different roles across rows, so the role and application keys are needed alongside the party key.

edge.rationale: party_activity.application_number and party_activity.ip_right_type identify the application the party-role record concerns.
